title: 第009章 赌坊失金账本飞第010章 酒楼库空酱题墙
lines: “富贵赌坊”的夜晚，比白天更喧嚣，也更浑浊。汗味、烟草味、劣质脂粉味、铜钱铁锈味，以及赌徒们身上散发出的那种混合了狂热、贪婪、恐惧的亢奋气息，在空气中发酵，令人头晕目眩。
秦夜再次改变了装束和容貌。他换上了一身半旧绸缎长衫，脸上多了两撇小胡子，肤色暗沉，眼角眉梢带着点长期熬夜的疲惫和市侩气，像个家道中落、但又放不下身段、混迹赌场企图翻本的破落子弟。他手里捏着几个铜板，随着人流挤进了赌坊大门。
赌坊内人声鼎沸，乌烟瘴气。几十张赌桌挤满了人，骰子撞击声、牌九摔打声、赌徒的吆喝和咒骂声、庄家唱喝声交织在一起，震耳欲聋。穿着统一短褂、眼神犀利的打手散布在赌场各处，虎视眈眈。
秦夜目光平静地扫过全场，没有在任何一个赌桌前停留，而是看似随意地在人群中穿梭，耳朵却捕捉着各种零碎的信息。
“……妈的，又输了！今天手气真背！”
“……买定离手！开！四五六，十五点大！”
“……听说没？刘三爷昨晚在快活林被人废了！两条胳膊都耷拉了，惨啊！”
“……嘘！小声点！不想活了？没看今天场子里多了好多生面孔？都是冲着那三千两黄金和破障丹来的！”
“……城主府这次是真急了，连‘鬼手’张老七都请出山了，据说在查刘三爷伤的手法……”
“……秦家也派了不少人，到处打听，还悬赏了五百两银子买那秦夜的消息……”
“……要我说，那秦夜八成早就逃出城了，谁还留在这儿等死？”
信息碎片涌入秦夜耳中。城主府果然请了懂行的人查验刀疤刘的伤势，不过“阎罗针法”岂是那么容易看透的？至于那些被悬赏吸引来的牛鬼蛇神，以及秦家的暗中搜捕，都在预料之中。
他的脚步，看似漫无目的，实则逐渐靠近赌坊深处，那片用屏风隔开、有专人把守的区域。那里是账房和存放现银、贵重筹码的库房所在，也是整个赌坊的核心。门口站着两个精壮的护卫，太阳穴高鼓，气息沉稳，都有淬体三重的样子，眼神锐利地扫视着靠近的每一个人。
秦夜没有靠近，而是转身走向一张玩骰子赌大小的赌桌。他挤在人群中，观察了几把。庄家是个山羊胡中年，手法娴熟，眼神精明。赌桌周围，有赢钱狂笑的，有输钱骂娘的，也有几个神色看似激动、实则目光游离、不时瞟向账房方向的人——那是赌坊安排的“暗灯”，防止有人出老千或闹事。
秦夜看准时机，在庄家摇完骰盅、众人下注的喧闹中，手腕几不可察地一抖。几点细微的、几乎看不见的粉尘，随着他扇动空气的动作，飘散出去，目标正是那个山羊胡庄家，以及他身边一个负责收钱赔付的伙计。
粉尘是他用山林里几种草药临时配置的，药性很弱，只会让人短时间内鼻腔发痒，忍不住想打喷嚏，注意力分散。
果然，不到半盏茶功夫，那庄家忽然皱了皱鼻子，脸色变得古怪，紧接着——
一个惊天动地的喷嚏打了出来，唾沫星子差点喷到赌桌上。他身旁那个伙计也几乎同时，连打了两个喷嚏，眼泪都飙出来了。
“妈的，怎么回事……”庄家揉了揉鼻子，有些尴尬，但赌局不能停，他强忍着继续吆喝，“买定离手！快！快！”
然而，他打喷嚏的瞬间，手法还是难免出现了一丝极其微小的迟滞和变形。这对普通人或许没影响，但对于某些一直全神贯注盯着他手法、等待机会的“老手”来说，这就是破绽！
赌桌一角，一个一直沉默寡言、穿着不起眼灰衣的瘦小汉子，眼中精光一闪，在庄家打喷嚏后、骰盅将落未落的那一刹那，指尖极其轻微地弹了一下。一道细若牛毛的劲气，无声无息地撞在骰盅底部，改变了里面一颗骰子细微的旋转角度。
“开！四四六，十四点大！”庄家揭开骰盅，唱喝道。
“哈哈！赢了！我押的大！”那瘦小汉子身边的几个托儿立刻欢呼起来，将自己和同伙的筹码推向“大”的区域。瘦小汉子自己也押了不少，这一把，赢面颇大。
庄家脸色一变，他是老手，立刻意识到刚才那喷嚏可能坏了事，这结果有点不对劲。他看了一眼那几个欢呼的赌客，又瞥了一眼那瘦小汉子，眼中闪过一丝疑虑，但众目睽睽之下，没有证据，他只能咬牙认赔。
赔付筹码时，庄家给了旁边一个暗灯一个眼色。那暗灯微微点头，不动声色地靠近了瘦小汉子那一伙人。
赌场里，因为这一把“意外”的大赔，气氛更加热烈，也更加混乱。人群拥挤，叫嚷声此起彼伏。
秦夜趁此机会，如同游鱼般滑出人群，借着混乱的掩护，迅速靠近了账房区域的屏风。他没有走正门，而是绕到侧面，那里有一扇通风用的小窗，用木条钉着，但缝隙不小。
他指尖凝聚真气，如同最精巧的刻刀，无声无息地将几根关键的木条从内部震断，却不使其脱落。然后，他取出一小截空心芦苇杆，从缝隙中探入，轻轻一吹。
一缕极淡的、无色无味的烟雾，顺着芦苇杆飘入账房。这是他用几种有安神、致幻效果的草药混合研磨而成，剂量很轻，不会让人立刻昏迷，但会让吸入者在短时间内精神恍惚，反应迟钝，产生困意。
账房里，一个戴着瓜皮帽、扒拉着算盘的老账房，和两个守着银箱的护卫，正有一搭没一搭地闲聊。忽然，老账房觉得眼皮有些发沉，打了个哈欠：“奇怪，今晚怎么这么困……”
一个护卫也揉了揉太阳穴：“是啊，感觉有点晕乎乎的……”
另一个护卫强打精神：“都精神点！这两天风声紧，别出岔子！”
但他们的话音越来越低，眼神也渐渐有些涣散，虽然还坐着，保持着清醒的姿态，但注意力已经无法集中。
秦夜等了片刻，估算药效已起作用。他再次震断一根木条，扩大缝隙，身体如同没有骨头一般，从那狭小的窗口钻了进去，落地无声。
账房不大，靠墙是几个沉重的包铁木箱，都上着锁。中间一张大桌，摆着账本、笔墨和算盘。老账房趴在桌上，似乎睡着了，两个护卫也靠着墙，闭着眼睛，呼吸均匀。
秦夜没有浪费时间。他先走到那几个银箱前，看了看锁。是常见的铜锁，结构简单。他从怀中取出一根特制的、略带弯曲的细铁丝——是他在山林里用树枝烧制打磨的，探入锁眼，轻轻拨弄了几下。
“咔哒。”
锁开了。
秦夜掀开箱盖，里面是码放整齐的银锭和铜钱，还有几串大钱和散碎银子，估计是今日的流水。他快速估算了一下，几个箱子加起来，现银大概有七八百两，铜钱若干。他没有全部拿走，那样太显眼，也重。他只取了大约三百两成色最好的银锭，用准备好的布包袱包好，又将一些散碎银子和铜钱扫入怀中。
然后，他走到账桌前。桌上摊开着今日的流水账本，上面密密麻麻记录着各桌的输赢和抽水。旁边还有几本厚厚的总账。
content_en:
The night of "Wealthy Gambling House" is more noisy and turbid than during the day. The smell of sweat, tobacco, inferior powder, copper coins and rust, as well as the excited smell of the gamblers mixed with fanaticism, greed, and fear, fermented in the air and made people dizzy.
Qin Ye changed his attire and appearance again. He put on a half-worn satin gown, and had two moustache on his face. His complexion was dark, and the corners of his eyes and eyebrows were a bit tired and philistine from staying up late for a long time. He looked like a down-and-out kid from a poor family who couldn't let go of his figure and hung out in casinos in an attempt to make a fortune. Holding a few copper coins in his hand, he squeezed through the gate of the casino with the flow of people.
The gambling house was full of people and filled with smoke. Dozens of gambling tables were crowded with people, and the sound of dice crashing, Pai Gow hitting, gamblers shouting and cursing, and dealers singing and drinking mixed together to make it deafening. Thieves wearing uniform short coats and sharp eyes were scattered throughout the casino, watching eagerly.
Qin Ye's eyes calmly swept across the entire venue, not stopping at any gambling table. Instead, he seemed to move through the crowd at random, but his ears captured all kinds of fragmentary information.
"...Damn, I lost again! I'm so unlucky today!"
"...Buy it and leave it! Let's go! Four, five, six, fifteen o'clock!"
"...Have you heard? Mr. Liu was crippled in Happy Forest last night! Both arms are drooped. How miserable!"
"...Shh! Keep your voice down! Don't want to live anymore? Didn't you see that there are so many new faces in the place today? They are all here for the three thousand taels of gold and the barrier-breaking pill!"
"...The City Lord's Mansion is really in a hurry this time. Even 'Ghost Hand' Zhang Laoqi has been invited to come out. It is said that he is investigating the method of Liu Sanye's injury..."
"...The Qin family also sent many people to inquire everywhere, and even offered a reward of 500 taels of silver for information about Qin Ye..."
"...If you ask me, Qin Ye probably escaped from the city long ago. Who is still here waiting to die?"
Fragments of information poured into Qin Ye's ears. As expected, the City Lord's Mansion hired knowledgeable people to examine Scar Liu's injuries, but how could the "Yam Luo Acupuncture Technique" be so easy to see through? As for the demons and monsters attracted by the bounties, as well as the Qin family's secret search, they were all expected.
His footsteps seemed aimless, but in fact they were gradually approaching the depths of the gambling house, an area separated by screens and guarded by special personnel. There is the accounting room and the warehouse where cash and valuable chips are stored. It is also the core of the entire gambling house. Two strong guards stood at the door. Their temples were bulging and their auras were steady. They both looked like they were at the third level of body tempering. Their eyes were scanning everyone who was approaching.
Qin Ye did not approach, but turned around and walked towards a gambling table where dice were played. He squeezed into the crowd and observed a few things. The banker is a middle-aged man with a goatee, skilled in skills and shrewd eyes. Around the gambling table, there were people who were laughing wildly when they won money, some who were scolding their mothers when they lost money, and there were also a few people who looked excited but actually had wandering eyes and glanced in the direction of the counting room from time to time - that was the "dark light" arranged by the gambling house to prevent anyone from cheating or causing trouble.
Qin Ye saw the right moment, and amid the bustle of the dealer shaking the dice cup and everyone placing bets, he made an almost imperceptible flick of his wrist. A few tiny, almost invisible specks of dust drifted out as he fanned the air, targeting the goatee dealer and the guy next to him who was responsible for collecting money and paying compensation.
The dust was temporarily prepared by him using several herbs from the mountains. The medicinal properties were very weak and would only make people's nasal passages itchy in a short period of time, making them want to sneeze and distracting them.
Sure enough, less than half a cup of tea later, the banker suddenly wrinkled his nose and his face became strange, and then——
"A-sneeze!"
An earth-shattering sneeze came out, and the saliva almost sprayed onto the gambling table. The guy next to him also sneezed twice at almost the same time, and tears burst out from his eyes.
"Damn, what's going on..." The banker rubbed his nose, feeling a little embarrassed, but the gambling couldn't stop. He suppressed and continued to shout, "Buy the deal and leave! Hurry! Hurry!"
However, the moment he sneezed, there was still a slight lag and deformation in his technique. This may not have any impact on ordinary people, but for some "veterans" who have been staring intently at his techniques and waiting for opportunities, this is a flaw!
At the corner of the gambling table, a thin man who had always been silent and dressed in inconspicuous gray clothes had a flash in his eyes. After the dealer sneezed and the dice cup was about to fall, he flicked his fingertips very slightly. A force as thin as an ox hair silently hit the bottom of the dice cup, changing the slight rotation angle of the dice inside.
"Open! Four-four-six, fourteen o'clock!" the dealer opened the dice cup and shouted.
"Haha! Won! I bet big!" Several stooges around the thin man immediately cheered and pushed their and their accomplices' chips into the "big" area. The thin man himself had bet a lot, so he had a good chance of winning this time.
The dealer's expression changed. He was a veteran, and he immediately realized that the sneeze just now might have caused trouble, and something was wrong. He glanced at the cheering gamblers, and then at the thin man. A trace of doubt flashed in his eyes, but in full view of the crowd and without evidence, he could only grit his teeth and admit his compensation.
When paying out the chips, the dealer gave a dark light next to him a wink. The dark lamp nodded slightly and quietly approached the thin man's group.
In the casino, the atmosphere became more lively and chaotic because of this "unexpected" big loss. The crowd was crowded and shouts came and went.
Qin Ye took this opportunity to slip out of the crowd like a fish, and quickly approached the screen in the counting room area under the cover of chaos. He did not go through the front door, but went around to the side. There was a small window for ventilation, nailed with wooden strips, but the gap was not small.
The Qi condensed on his fingertips, like the most delicate carving knife, silently broke several key wooden bars from the inside without causing them to fall off. Then, he took out a small hollow reed rod, stuck it in through the gap, and blew gently.
A wisp of very light, colorless and odorless smoke floated along the reed pole into the accounting room. This was made by mixing and grinding several herbs with soothing and hallucinogenic effects. The dosage is very light and will not cause people to fall into coma immediately, but will make the person who inhales it feel trance-like, slow to react, and drowsy in a short period of time.
In the accounting room, an old accounting clerk wearing a melon cap and holding an abacus was chatting with two guards guarding the silver box. Suddenly, the old accountant felt that his eyelids were a little heavy and he yawned: "Strange, why are you so sleepy tonight..."
One of the guards also rubbed his temples: "Yeah, I feel a little dizzy..."
Another guard braced himself: "Everyone, please be alert! The wind has been tight these two days, so don't make any mistakes!"
But their voices became lower and lower, and their eyes gradually became unfocused. Although they were still sitting and keeping their heads above water, they could no longer concentrate.
Qin Ye waited for a moment and estimated that the medicine had taken effect. He broke a wooden bar again, widening the gap. As if his body had no bones, he got through the narrow window and landed silently.
The accounting room is not big. Against the wall are several heavy iron-clad wooden boxes, all of which are locked. There is a large table in the middle with account books, pens and ink, and an abacus. The old accountant was lying on the table, seemingly asleep, and the two guards were also leaning against the wall, with their eyes closed and breathing evenly.
Qin Ye didn't waste time. He first walked to the silver boxes and looked at the locks. It is a common copper lock with simple structure. He took out a special, slightly curved thin iron wire from his arms, which he had burned and polished from tree branches in the forest. He reached into the keyhole and fiddled with it a few times.
"Click."
The lock is unlocked.
Qin Ye opened the lid of the box. Inside were neatly arranged silver ingots and copper coins, as well as several strings of large coins and scattered silver, which were probably from today's turnover. He made a quick estimate and found that the sum of several boxes contained about seven or eight hundred taels of silver and a certain amount of copper coins. He didn't take them all, that would be too conspicuous and heavy. He only took about three hundred taels of the finest silver ingots, wrapped them in the prepared cloth bag, and swept some scattered silver and copper coins into his arms.
Then he walked to the accounting table. Today's running ledger is spread out on the table, with the winnings, losses and rake of each table densely recorded on it. There are several thick general ledgers next to it.
title_en: Chapter 009 The ledger of lost money in the gambling house flew away Chapter 010 The empty wall in the restaurant
